basic_info.description: Multiple levels of spacious living encompass this lovely Bayview Heights home! From its freshly painted facade to its tidy backyard to the expansive views, 1010 Ingerson presents a surprising combination of livability and affordability. All levels are joined by a central staircase, yet each floor also has a secondary side entrance allowing for flexible living scenarios.  On the main level, you'll find an expansive living room, guest bedroom w/ full bath and amazing kitchen/great room combo w/ cathedral ceiling and deck access.  The middle level includes laundry and two additional ensuite rooms, one of which is a primary bedroom with lovely eastern exposure and garden views. The private lower level presents a comfortable and quiet environment offering numerous options: 4th bedroom, WFH space, recreation room, etc. There is also direct walk-out access to the flat, easy-to-maintain backyard.    The home has upgraded electrical and plumbing systems, concrete foundation and dual forced air furnaces.  MUNI T-line, Hwy 101 and Bayview Caltrain Station are all minutes away as are the Gilman Playground, Candlestick Recreation Area and Sunrise Point Fishing Pier.   There's a lot to love at 1010 Ingerson!
